description: SvCheckBox in a Svelte 5 role-permissions block: a tri-state select-all parent that shows indeterminate when only some children are checked, child checkboxes per permission, and a required terms checkbox with validation that blocks submit until it is ticked. Controlled through checked, indeterminate and onChange.

faq.question: How does the select-all parent work?
faq.answer: Its checked is true when every child is on and its indeterminate is true when some are; onChange toggles every child at once. Both flags are $derived from the children's state.

faq.question: How is the terms checkbox validated?
faq.answer: It carries required and an error message; the form's submit checks the value and the checkbox shows the message until it is ticked.

faq.question: Does it work as a grid cell editor?
faq.answer: Yes. A column with editorType 'checkbox' mounts the same component in the cell.
